3490-5231-6996-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6996-8333.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3240-6277-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1263-4871-5670-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-4871-5670-6578.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Sephiroth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4694-7306-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-7306-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

225-3129-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-3129-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

206-1563-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

215-1526-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-7060.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2113-3525-3711.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

64-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
64-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
64-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1355-7500.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six enchantments.
1355-7500.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

1734-2034-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-2034-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

628-6798-7198.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2919-4365-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4365-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

2464-3713-5078-6918.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3713-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2034-3490-7080.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Sandbender Scavengers triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-5900-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-5900-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

4872-5626-6991.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
4872-5626-6991.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
4872-5626-6991.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Donnie & April from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Donnie & April, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

229-5660-5684.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-2448-4616-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-4616-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-3480-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

628-6798-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-6798-6863--133.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
628-6798-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

1874-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
1874-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

474-4050-4394-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {1}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1669-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-1669-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

uses.n: Marang River Regent // Coil and Catch

380-6440-6589.description:
Cast Marang River Regent by paying {0} due to Dracogenesis.
When Marang River Regent enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Marang River Regent trigger, returning up to two other nonland permanents to their owners' hands.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Marang River Regent.
When the Marang River Regent token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Marang River Regent and up to one other nonland permanent to their owners' hands.
Repeat.

2511-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2511-3560-5972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

813-3603-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Cloudshift.
813-3603-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4616-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4616-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

997-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
997-3293-5282.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1445-1879-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1879-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2034-2105-2923.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding {C}{C}
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

629-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gruff Triplets, adding {C}{C}.
When Gruff Triplets dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Gruff Triplets triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control named Gruff Triplets equal to the sacrificed Gruff Triplets' power.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Gruff Triplets from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gruff Triplets enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Gruff Triplets token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1580-1599-1636-3263.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Yawgmoth does not have summoning sickness.
1580-1599-1636-3263.description:
Activate Priest of Yawgmoth by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1999-2793-5159.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2793-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to hand, choosing not to put an artifact onto the battlefield.
At the beginning of your end step, Mishra triggers, causing you to exile Mishra's Warform and take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.
